QuestInfo.name: A Helping Hand
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: As promised, you have received another gift from the Administrator.
QuestInfo.2: You received a gift from the Administrator. You will be given another gift upon hitting level 50.

0.0: Hiya, #h0#! Have you reached Lv. 50 already? It's wonderful to see you developing so quickly. Well, here's the gift I promised you.

yes.0: Open your Inventory and check out your gifts! These items will make you look awesome! I can't wait to see what you do next!

no.0: Oh, you don't want a gift? Okay. Talk to me if you change your mind.
